current.text: He is out with a torn shoulder. The newest note calls it a torn labrum. An August note called it a torn rotator cuff.
He is expected to miss most of the regular season and not return until after the All-Star break.
If healthy, he could have gained a role from the Clippers' other injuries.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule: 4, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21. They also have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league, with 13.
Experts expect the Clippers to be one of the worst teams. They expect a trial season with long rotations, and coach Ty Lue often changes his rotation choices.

note: Do not draft him. He ranks 310 on Yahoo and 349 on ESPN, both sites price him at 0 USD, and he is out until after the All-Star break, so he will not be in our 144-player pool. Last season he played 22 minutes a game and averaged 10 points on 53.1% FG with few threes, rebounds or defensive stats. That is not a profile worth stashing in an IL slot. When he returns in late February, check his minutes on waivers. The Clippers play 4-3-4 in our playoff weeks, so a real role could make him a short-term streamer.
